goal: Allow RPC callers to request feerate outputs directly in sat/vB
Eliminates client-side unit conversions and rounding errors in sub-1 sat/vB conditions
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no known blocking issues
agreement: Strong support for backwards-compatible migration to sat/vB (musaHaruna, willcl-ark)
Approvals without stated reasons after fixes (w0xlt)
Resolved objections over decimal precision and keeping existing default formats (glozow, maflcko)
